summary: Interprets receipt 3324fe87d6da49c6b53eab0e116823df, the clean-copy repeat of the corrected leadership-transfer experiment, and folds it into the account (f7da39e9771e40d29f8d7ec3d1c7d886-question-0). The repeat reproduced the pair the account rests on: the voter control installed the named target with an error-free future in 2 ms and no leaderless samples, while the transfer to a member whose own configuration reported non-voter completed in 2 ms without error, installed nobody, and left six 10 ms samples without a leader, with the target and every other member advancing to term 4. Because both corrected runs record demotion_converged at 0 ms and target_role_in_own_config=nonvoter at request time, the account can now state that result as observed twice rather than once. Counterevidence and limitations were updated to cover three trigger runs (8, 7 and 6 leaderless samples, about 60 to 80 ms), and joint_history places the repeat as a clean-copy re-execution of the third revision with identical cases, admissions and assertions. Knowledge entries f7da39e9771e40d29f8d7ec3d1c7d886-knowledge-0 and -1 carry the new receipt's executions unchanged in substance; the rationale also had a stray word corrected to 'Mechanism from source'. Conclusion stays violated with the defect asserted, and the submission validates with zero schema errors, requesting no execution.
